title: Independent Thought v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Independent Thought v. Union of India, (2017) 10 SCC 800
content.holding: The marital-rape exception cannot apply to a wife under 18. The exception in s. 63 must be read with this holding and the POCSO overlap.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (2017) 10 SCC 800; 2017 INSC 1025; Exception 2 to Section 375 IPC struck down for minor wives.
